classes.AI_OCR_Receiver: Apply to an XUpload field that should receive OCR-extracted text. The OCR result is placed into the element matching data-cb-Field.
classes.AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Input: Apply to the text input field of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
classes.AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Send: Apply to the send button of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
classes.AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Stop: Apply to the stop button of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
classes.AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Upload: Apply to the file upload button of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
classes.AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Thinking: Apply to the thinking indicator element of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
classes.AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Internet: Apply to the internet search toggle of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
classes.AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Location: Apply to the location sharing button of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
classes.AI_LLAMA_CHAT_MailForward: Apply to the mail forward button of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
classes.AI_LLAMA_CHAT_MailAddress: Apply to the mail address input of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
classes.AI_LLAMA_CHAT_AlertOnFinish: Apply to the alert-on-finish toggle of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
classes.AI_LLAMA_QA_Exclude: Apply to a container (XContainer) element whose contents should be excluded from AI question search.
classes.AI_LLAMA_STANDARD_QA_Question: Apply to an XTextField that receives AI responses to questions specified in data-cb-Question.
classes.AI_LLAMA_STANDARD_TXTQA_Question: Apply to an XTextField that receives AI responses to questions based on source fields.
classes.AI_LLAMA_TXTQA_Source: Apply to an XTextField whose value should be supplied as source context to the AI for question answering.
